list.title: Accounts

empty.title: No accounts yet — add one to start recording

list.archive_confirm: Once archived, you can't record transactions on it or use it as an import target, but its history is kept. Its balance of {{balance}} will be removed from net worth.
list.delete_disabled_hint: This account has transactions — archive it instead
list.no_rate_hint: {{count}} accounts can't be converted right now

form.name_duplicate_hint: There's already an account with this name — they're still tracked separately
form.currency_locked_hint: An account's currency can't be changed after it's created — changing it would muddle past transactions. To switch currency, create a new account and archive this one.
form.opening_balance_hint: Balance = opening balance + the sum of every transaction on this account. The opening balance lives on the account, not as a transaction — it won't show up in the transaction list.
form.credit_debt_hint: Enter how much you currently owe the bank — it's stored as a negative number
form.opening_balance_change_confirm: This immediately affects all historical balances and net worth. Save anyway?
